text:
zara: RC-0.18.0 blocked by a regen-induced diff in the TS SDK. Sample-app onboarding CI failed and semver guard bumped the publish because CHANGELOG auto-tagged as minor. Anyone free to triage?
matt: Can you paste the CI link and the diff?
zara: https://ci.internal/17699 job 3. Diff snippet:
```
- export interface CreateThing { name: string; meta?: Record<string, any>; flags?: string[] }
+ export interface CreateThing { meta?: Record<string, any>; name: string; flags?: string[] }
```
zara: Looks like property ordering changed again; also generator upgrade seems to have changed "required" inference in one place (noted in a separate file).
ci-bot: publish-gate: blocked -> type-hash mismatch detected. See https://ci.internal/reports/17699. Semver-check failed: CHANGELOG lists a "minor" entry for unrelated churn.
dx-bot: Observations: 1) Non-spec change causing typegen ordering drift; 2) Auto changelog tooling misclassified a chore PR as minor. Two-prong fix recommended: enforce deterministic property ordering in typegen config + adjust changelog entry to patch-level wording.
matt: Proposal: open a small PR that sets `generator.stableSort=true` in tools/typegen/config.yml, regen types, update package metadata (type-hash), and edit CHANGELOG.md line to: "patch(sdk): regen parity fix (no user-facing changes)". Run local sample-app smoke and push.
zara: Agree but we must avoid direct edits to the OpenAPI spec. Also include before/after diffs in PR body and add `changelog-bot:manual-override` to prevent automation from reverting the wording.
matt: I'll run: `yarn tools:typegen --stableSort && yarn sample-app:test --smoke` locally then open PR. If the CI still flakes, we'll request a release exception.
release-ops: If PR doesn't clear CI, submit an exception request with: exact regen commands, before/after diffs, smoke logs, and statement "non-user-facing SDK parity". We'll fast-track approval if evidence is clear.
ci-bot: build queued for matt/regen-stableSort (job 3).
zara: Please tag me and @release-ops when PR is up so we can validate changelog wording and request exception only if necessary. Thanks :thumbsup:
matt: PR opened in ~15m with all artifacts and label `release:regen-fix`. Will add changelog manual note and cc dx-bot for review.
